newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average settled down 8.51 points at 5,868.85 on Thursday after surprisingly downbeat economic news sparked a late sell-off of economically sensitive shares.
** State-owned Bank BNI is expected to allocate around 500 million shares, or some 50 percent of total shares to be floated on the local exchanges in November, for pension funds and insurance firms.
** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.03 points, or 0.18 percent, to close at 571.26 on Thursday on foreign selling of selected blue-chips despite a significant rise in market heavyweight Telkom.
** On Friday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,318.50/19.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,318.50/19.50.
** Astra on unconfirmed reports that President Suharto's daughter Siti Hardianti Rukmana was about to buy timber tycoon Prajogo Pangestu's stake in the car manufacturer.
** Berlian Laju Tanker on an announcement that the shipping firm had bought a 20 percent stake worth $1,433,788 in Malaysia's Merchant Marine Sdn Bhd.
** Timber firm Barito Pacific on an announcement that its first-half net profit in 1996 was lower than the same period last year.
